derivation:
by
  simpa only [Units.val_mul, Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.coe_scalar, Matrix.scalar_apply] using
    Matrix.diagonal_mul (fun _ : Fin 2 => (c : R)) (g : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R) i j
explanation: Specialize the diagonal entries to the constant c and the matrix to the underlying matrix of g. Coercion simplification identifies the scalar GL matrix with this diagonal matrix. The current proof instead uses Matrix.smul_eq_diagonal_mul.
